stem: On a train from Lahore to Karachi, 64 passengers have business-class tickets and the rest have economy-class tickets. Of the business-class passengers, 75% are traveling for work. If a passenger is selected at random from the passengers traveling for work, the probability that the passenger has a business-class ticket is \(\frac{3}{8}\). How many economy-class passengers are traveling for work?
solution: Let \(w\) be the number of all passengers traveling for work. Then \(\frac{48}{w} = \frac{3}{8}\), so \(w = 128\).
verify:
w = symbols('w')
bw = Rational(75, 100) * 64
assert bw == 48
tot = solve(Eq(bw / w, Rational(3, 8)), w)[0]
assert tot == 128
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [tot - bw]
